subject: CONFIDENTIALITY: press timing & reference rights — MSA/Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CONFIDENTIALITY: press timing & reference rights — MSA/Order Form redlines

Elaine / Brightline legal team —

Thanks for the productive conversation yesterday. Attached are the current MSA and Order Form redlines from our side (MSA_Redline_KI_20261112.docx, OrderForm_v3_BRI_20261112.pdf). A few discrete asks to move this along so procurement can finish ASAP: 

- Confidentiality window: we proposed a 12 month confidentiality period for pilot pricing and technical details. Brightline's earlier redline requested indefinite confidentiality for pricing; can you confirm whether a 12-month carveout (with narrow exceptions for aggregated metrics) would work?
- Press/embargo: we're requesting a 60-day embargo after mutual sign-off on the pilot outcomes; Brightline previously asked for 90 days. Can we find middle ground?
- Logo and reference rights: we ask for a standard asset license limited to case study/press use with customer approval required for exact quotes/screenshots. Brightline's redline removed the explicit logo scope; Kimberly, please advise on safe language below.
- Evidence & approvals: Brightline will need to provide logo files and an approved quote. If procurement prefers, we can add an assets escrow line in the Order Form (see OrderForm_v3).

Please see the attached redlines and the draft PR plan (PR_Plan_Brightline_draft.pdf). Sam (cc'd on follow-ups) is Brightline's PR — if Brightline legal is comfortable with a compromise on embargo and a limited logo license with prior approval, we can finalize the Order Form and push for signature this week.

Next steps requested:
1) Elaine/legal: confirm acceptable confidentiality duration and whether aggregated metrics carveout is OK.
2) Brightline PR: confirm expected internal timeline to approve a quote + logo pack.
3) Kimberly/legal (Redwood): quick read of these redline changes (below I pulled the key clauses).

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: MSA_Redline_KI_20261112.docx (annotated), OrderForm_v3_BRI_20261112.pdf, PR_Plan_Brightline_draft.pdf

From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightline.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brightline Legal <legal@brightline.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@agilepr.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: CONFIDENTIALITY: press timing & reference rights — MSA/Order Form redlines

Karthik —

Thanks for the redlines and the PR draft. We reviewed internally this morning. High level from Brightline legal / operations:

- Confidentiality: we are uncomfortable with automatic expiration of confidentiality for pricing tied to a pilot; pricing is commercially sensitive. Our ask was to keep pricing confidential indefinitely unless both parties agree to disclose. However, we can consider a 12–24 month window for non-pricing technical data.
- Press/embargo: 90 days is our baseline due to partner coordination and board notice windows. 60 would be tighter than we prefer.
- Logos & references: we can agree to limited logo usage for case studies, but require a one-week minimum review period for quotes and screenshots, and explicit 'no endorsement' language. We also require that any use of customer logos in marketing material be limited to the asset pack we provide.

I am attaching Brightline's marketing requirements doc for reference (Brightline_Marketing_Requirements.pdf). Sam (PR) is looped in — he can confirm timelines for approvals.

If Kimberly from Redwood legal can propose compromise language on the pricing confidentiality carveout and a clearer definition for 'aggregated metrics', we can move forward.

–Elaine
Elaine Park | Head of Partnerships, Brightline Systems
elaine@brightline.com | +1 312-555-0148

Attachment: Brightline_Marketing_Requirements.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightline.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CONFIDENTIALITY: press timing & reference rights — MSA/Order Form redlines

Elaine / Karthik —

Thanks for the context, Elaine. Quick read of the redlines and two suggested edits from Redwood legal to keep the deal moving while protecting both parties: 

1) Pricing confidentiality: propose language that keeps specific unit pricing and discounts confidential indefinitely, but permits disclosure of the existence of the agreement and non-price performance metrics after 12 months. Suggested clause snippet: "Customer Confidential Information does not include aggregated or anonymized performance metrics that cannot be reverse-engineered to reveal pricing or customer-identifiable details."

2) Embargo window: acceptable middle ground is 45 days from mutual sign-off on final case study text (not pilot completion). That gives Brightline more review time than 60-day ask, but shortens Brightline's 90-day request.

3) Logo & assets: add a short Order Form addendum: "Customer will provide logo files and a designated approval contact; Redwood will not publish press materials containing Customer logos or quotes without Customer's prior written approval, which Customer will provide or deny within 7 business days of submission." If Brightline wants an escrow, we can add an assets escrow checkbox in the Order Form options.

4) Evidence requests: marketing collateral or screenshots that include PII must be redacted; for auditability, provide SOC2 evidence link or a representative attestation. Logan, can you push the SOC2 evidence link to the shared drive?

If we can get Brightline to accept: (a) indefinite price confidentiality; (b) 45-day embargo post-approval; (c) seven-business-day approval window for assets; we will accept the revised Order Form and send for signature.

-Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightline.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@agilepr.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CONFIDENTIALITY: press timing & reference rights — MSA/Order Form redlines

Elaine / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Kimberly. Elaine, thanks for Brightline's notes. To keep momentum and avoid procurement delays, Redwood proposes the following compromise so we can proceed to signature this week: 

- Pricing: Redwood accepts Brightline's request to keep specific pricing/discounts confidential indefinitely; Redwood reserves the right to state that a commercial agreement exists (no pricing disclosed).
- Confidentiality carveout: non-price performance metrics can be publicly referenced after 12 months but limited to aggregated format that cannot be mapped to specific Brightline customers or pricing tiers.
- Embargo: agree to 45-day embargo from mutual sign-off on final case study text.
- Assets & approvals: Brightline provides a logo pack and a designated approver; Redwood will submit final draft for 7 business day review. If no response, approval is deemed given. We will add an 'assets escrow' checkbox in Order Form_v3 to make this explicit.

If Brightline confirms these points, I'll have Procurement pull the updated Order Form and route for DocuSign. Our target: finalize signatures by EOD Friday (11/13). Deal id: BRI-2026-0421.

Marissa / Logan: please prep the Order Form variant with the escrow checkbox and push SOC2 link to the shared drive (see related links).

Thanks —
Karthik

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@agilepr.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@brightline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: CONFIDENTIALITY: press timing & reference rights — MSA/Order Form redlines

Folks —

Sounds good. From PR perspective: 45-day embargo is workable if we receive the following from Brightline at least 14 days before embargo lift:
- Final approved quote and attribution line
- High-res logo pack and usage guidelines (EPS/PNG)
- Any legal notice text Brightline requires to appear in the release

I will draft the press release and share with both teams for review. Proposed next steps:
1) Brightline to upload logo pack to the PR folder in Drive (link above) by COB Monday.
2) Redwood to circulate final one-page case study draft by Wednesday for Brightline's 7 business day review.
3) Procurement to confirm DocuSign route and ETA.

Happy to sync briefly if anyone wants to run through the timeline.

—Sam
